newsitem.title: USA: Basin's Eugene wells begin production.
newsitem.headline: Basin's Eugene wells begin production.

text.p: Basin Exploration Inc on Thursday said two wells on Eugene Island Block 65 have begun producing, and initially reached daily rates of 51 millon cubic feet of natural gas and 1,700 barrels of condensate.

The company said in a news release that it currently is restricting production to 45 million cubic feet of natural gas and 1,400 barrels of condesate per day, keeping them below contraints imposed by pipeline pressure and facilities.
Eugene Island Block 65 is located in shallow waters in the Gulf of Mexico off Louisiana.
Basin also said an exploratory Gulf of Mexico well on South Marsh Island Block 251, in which it had a 60 percent working interest, was unsuccessful.
